name: Psychiatry & medication (category guide)
summary: Psychiatrist vs psychologist/counsellor — private fee bands, prescription continuity for expats, and confidentiality myths that keep people from booking.
body: Psychiatrists are medical doctors who diagnose and prescribe; psychologists and counsellors provide therapy and do not replace medication management when that is indicated. Expat threads often chase ‘private so it stays off a public record’ — clinical records are confidential either pathway, but private clinics trade higher cash fees (often low-to-mid hundreds SGD per consult in forum quotes) for shorter waits and easier English continuity. Bring overseas scripts and HSA import paperwork; stimulant / controlled meds need a local prescribing plan before the suitcase supply runs out. Group outpatient riders frequently carve psychiatry or cap sessions — get the schedule in writing. Distinct from mental-health counselling category listings that cover therapy shopping. This is a category guide, not a ranked psychiatrist list.
